summary: Scully Royalty Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, announcing a management change: Chairman Michael Smith was appointed interim CEO and CFO, replacing Samuel Morrow, who remains as a non-executive director with no management duties. The move follows no disclosed termination or performance issue; the company states it will seek permanent candidates. This is a board-led leadership transition disclosed via a press release. Terms are limited to the appointment and interim role. No advisors, financial terms, or transaction details are mentioned. What to watch: whether permanent appointments occur and whether Morrow's departure signals strategic shifts.
